Introduction:

60 Days Visit Visa for UAE Price is probably the first thing that comes to mind when you’re planning a long trip. Having this permit allows you to stay longer in the UAE. It means you have the freedom to live beyond the standard 30 days. The best part? You’re free from the commitment of long residency or work permits. It’s either you need a relaxed holiday or visiting family. Whatever the reason is, the right visa at the right price matters the most.

The guide focuses on:

  • The updated costs
  • Eligibility rules
  • Documents needed
  • The application process
  • Renewal and extension options, and
  • Key tips to avoid mistakes.

You’ll also learn about the detailed comparison of other visa durations and share traveler feedback. Therefore, making informed decisions will be easy for you.

A 60-Day Visit Visa Explained:

A 60-day visit visa is designed for foreigners to stay more than a month. Under this visa, you can live in the UAE for 60 days from the date of entry. Famous for longer stays that go beyond one month. Visiting the UAE to explore it? The visa lets visitors experience local culture. Complete business tasks or visit loved ones without rushing with this visa freely. You don’t need an employer to sponsor you. It is not a work permit. Therefore, no paid employment is allowed under this visa type.

Who should apply for it?

We’ve gathered a list of categories that are qualified to apply for this visa:

  • Tourist
  • Family visitors,
  • Job seekers, and
  • Business visitors

Ideal for employers who need more time than a 30-day visa. They usually opt for this visa.

What is the Difference between short-term and long-term UAE visas?

There are two types of visit visas. The short-term visa is for a short duration. The long-term visa is for a long period. Short-term tourist or visit visas are generally for 30 to 60 days. The visa is mainly for leisure or visit purposes. On the other hand, long-term visas include work visas, residence visas, and investor visas. This visa type requires sponsors and more paperwork.

Updated Price of 60 Days UAE Visit Visa (2026):

The 60-Day Visit Visa for the UAE Price varies depending on your visa requirement. The single or multiple entries have a different fee. The processing speed also decides your cost. Plus, the service charges or travel agency fees included or not will further give a clear figure.

Single-entry visa fees:

This visa has a price range of 300 to 600 dirhams. Under which, you can spend a standard 60-day in the UAE with a single entry. The prices depend on the processing source.

Multiple-entry visa fees

This visa price lies between 500 and 1000 dirham. The visa allows you to live for a 60-day period in the UAE. However, the multiple-entry permit gives you the authority to visit as many times as you want until your visa is valid.

Price Comparison Table (in AED)

Here’s the price comparison between the two visas. The prices are gathered in a tabular form for your best understanding.

 

Visa Type UAE Visit Visa 2 Months Price (Approx.)
60-Day Single Entry AED 300–600
60-Day Multiple Entry AED 500–1000

 

Important Note:
The prices are estimated and tend to change. It varies depending on your UAE 60-day visa requirements. That’s why it’s best to talk to us if you need accurate figures based on your visa case.

Who Can Qualify for a 60-Day UAE Visit Visa?

The following are the eligible categories to apply for a visit visa for the UAE.

Eligibility by nationality & age:

There’s no restriction on nationalities. Most nationalities can apply for a 60-day visit visa. However, they must hold a passport valid for at least six months. Some nationalities may receive visas on arrival. On the other hand, others must apply in advance.

Family & dependent visitors:

Do you want to bring your family to the UAE? The idea is great! This visa works well for family members visiting relatives in the UAE. You can sponsor dependent visitors if you are a resident. Plus, you can also apply as a tourist invitee with accommodation and ticket details.

Other visitor types:

The other visitors who use this visa for extended stays are:

  • Business visitors
  • Cultural event participants, and
  • Educational travelers

Documents Required for Application:

Now, understand what documents you may need to apply for your visit visa.

Passport & photo requirements

  • Valid passport with at least 6 months’ validity
  • Passport-size photo (white background)
  • New update: passport outer cover page copy now required for many visa applications in 2025–26.

Supporting documents for family or multiple entries

  • Confirmed return/onward flight ticket
  • Hotel or host accommodation proof
  • Bank statements or financial evidence

Are there any other essential documents?

You might also require travel medical insurance. If it’s not required, it’s recommended to go for it. In some cases, you are needed to provide sponsor details for family or resident-sponsored visas, too.

Steps Involved in Application Process:

From start to end, the entire process of visa application has been discussed in steps.

Online application (GDRFA/UAE portal):

Applying online will save you time. You can apply via the UAE immigration portals. Use ICA Smart Services or GDRFA regional portals. Here, you’ll need to upload your documents and make the payment.

Applying via travel agencies or VFS centers:

Find it hard to use online portals? There is an alternate method. Many applicants use licensed agents or airline partner portals. On your behalf, they handle paperwork and submission. So you’ll be free from missing any important detail in the application submission.

Tips to avoid mistakes & rejection:

Make your first attempt successful by following our top tips:

  • Validate passport scans are clear and complete
  • Match all names exactly as on the passport
  • Submit the return ticket and accommodation proof

60-day visit visa UAE Processing Time:

Discover the processing time, the factors that affect your approval times, and the visa application tracking procedure.

Average duration for approval:

The standard processing time of a 60-day visit visa usually takes around 3 to 4 working days.

Factors affecting processing time:

These are the common factors that might affect your processing time. This includes:

  • Nationality
  • Application channel, and
  • Peak travel seasons

They may impact approval times.

How to track your application?

Tracking your visa application is easy. Start by using the reference number provided at submission. This way, you can easily track the visa status online.

Visa Renewal and Extension Options:

The visa expires after 60 days. After this, you have to renew it anyway. You also have an option to extend your visa while it is valid. The renewal and extension process is as follows:

How to extend a 60-day visit visa?

You can apply to extend your 60-day stay for an additional period. To extend your visa, you don’t even have to exit the UAE. The process depends on the visa type and rules.

Renewal fees and rules:

Visa extensions cost you around 1000+ dirhams per period. It also includes service fees.

When and how to apply for renewal?

You should apply at least 5 to 7 days before the visa expiration. This helps you avoid fines and complications that may arise.

Benefits of 60 Days Visit Visa:

A UAE visit visa for 60 days offers you many benefits. From achieving flexibility to enjoying multiple entries, let’s find out the perks it provides.

Flexibility for tourists:

A 60-Day Visit Visa for the UAE Price gives you two full months. It’s enough time to explore cities, beaches, and landmarks.

Multiple entry advantage:

Choosing a multiple-entry version lets you enter and exit the UAE within the 60-day validity period.

Cost-effectiveness compared to longer visas:

The option of a 60-day permit is more affordable and easier to obtain in comparison to a 90-day or longer permit.

Current Price of 60 Days UAE Visit Visa in 2026

Single-entry visa fees

The single-entry visa permits you to enter once and stay for the permitted duration until your visa expires. Once you exit the UAE, the visa becomes invalid, even if days remain. Actual fees vary by sponsor. It is also dependent on your processing speed, insurance, and add-ons. The price for a single-entry visa for 60 days falls between 300 and 600 dirhams.

Multiple-entry visa fees:

Costs are higher if you want the flexibility to enter and exit the UAE multiple times within the visa period. Many agents list prices in the range of 500 to 1000 dirhams. The prices may vary according to variables. Confirm with your chosen sponsor before paying.

Price in AED & INR for different nationalities (India & Pakistan)

Visa costs are broadly similar for most nationalities. However, local pricing and exchange rates affect the INR equivalent.

Price Table (Indicative 2026):

Visa Type Total Fee in AED Rough INR/PKR Equivalent
60-day single entry AED 300–600 ~₹12,500–₹20,000 / PKR 65,000–75,000
60-day multiple entry AED 500–1000 ~₹18,000–₹28,000 / PKR 120,000–125,000

Pros and Cons of 60 Days UAE Visit Visa:

Understand the visa cons and pros of the 60-day visit visa for the UAE.

Advantages:

The benefits you’ll get are:

  • Affordable extended stay compared to longer visas
  • Ease of application via online or agent channels
  • Good for families and leisure trips

Limitations:

Despite the benefits, it has some limitations:

  • Cannot work in the UAE legally
  • Renewal adds extra cost
  • Overstay fines are strict (daily fines apply)

Situations when it may not be ideal:

The visa is not suitable if you plan employment, residency, or longer business activities. There are other visa types to fulfill these visit purposes.

Comparison with Other Visit Visas:

Now, discussing the detailed comparison of this visa with other visas.

30-day vs 60-day vs 90-day visa:

The UAE no longer issues 90-day stays universally. Therefore, 60 days is the most robust standard for longer stays.

Best choice for tourists, families, and business visitors:

The visit visa for 60 days strikes a balance between time and cost for most travelers.

Price and duration comparison table:

Understand the price comparison among these visas.

 

Visa Duration Max Stay Estimated Price (AED)
30 Days 1 Month AED 200
60 Days 2 Months AED 300
90 Days Not always available Varies

 

Important Note:

The total amount may vary. The visa price may increase or decrease. It depends on the circumstances.

Personal Experience & Travel Tips:

We are going to share our valuable insights that help you make an informed decision about this visa. This 60-day visit visa is best suited to individuals who are searching for an option to stay beyond one month in the UAE. It’s plenty of time to do business meetings, visit your relatives, explore the country, and move across cities. You can also extend this visa. The renewal process is also easy, allowing you to spend some more time in the UAE. You can decide between a single entry or multiple entries under this visa. Both can be obtained based on your travel plan.

Traveler experiences & lessons learned:

Many travelers report smooth approvals when applying for a visit visa. Be wise to apply early to avoid stress and last-minute surprises. Plus, you must have proper proof of travel plans and finances.

Tips to avoid mistakes:

Make sure to double-check your passport validity. Prepare all documents in advance to eliminate any delay. Most importantly, avoid unofficial “quick visa” offers that might be scams.

Recommended checklist for UAE visitors:

Keep this checklist in your pocket if you visit the UAE for the first time on a visit visa.

  • Passport (with cover page)
  • Return flight ticket
  • Hotel booking/host address
  • Travel insurance

Final Verdict:

Holding a 60-day visit visa grants you the flexibility to travel at your own pace without rushing. Visit your family, travel wherever you want, or plan business trips with peace of mind. Two months are enough to spend quality time or to achieve some future endeavour. Either pick a single-entry visa or a multiple-entry, the choice is yours. Both are amazing choices. But these decisions are made on your personal or professional needs.

Looking for one? Get help from Connect Freelance to grab your visit visa today. Sit back and relax while we do the rest.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

How much is a 60-day UAE visa?

The UAE 60-day visit visa costs you around:

  • 300 to 600 dirhams for a single entry
  • 500 to 1000 dirhams for multiple entries.

How long does it take to get a 60-day visa for Dubai?

The visa application for a 60-day visa for Dubai takes around 3 to 4 working days to process.

Can we extend a 60-day visit visa in the UAE?

Absolutely! You can renew and even extend your visit visa in the UAE with an additional fee.

Do I need a sponsor for a UAE visit visa?

No. You don’t require any sponsor for UAE tourist visas. It is a requirement for other visa types, like an employment visa, etc.

What documents are needed for a UAE visa?

These documents are required to apply for a visit visa for the UAE:

  • Passport
  • Photo
  • Ticket
  • Hotel/proof of stay.

Is a return ticket needed for a UAE visit visa?

Of course. You require a return or onward ticket for a UAE visit visa.
